one_liner: Smartsheet offers a REST API and official MCP server for productivity and project management tasks.
gating_notes: API access requires a Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management plan. Personal Access Tokens are generated in the UI.
oauth_details: OAuth 2.0 is recommended for multi-user integrations and SaaS products, allowing least-privilege access via scopes.

auth_methods.quote: The API authenticates using access tokens (API keys). You can generate access tokens in the Smartsheet UI. Each API request requires passing in an access token as the Bearer value in your authorization header.

primary_auth.quote: OAuth 2.0 is the right choice for multi-user integrations, SaaS products, or anything where you're acting on behalf of other people's Smartsheet accounts.

credential_access.quote: Required plan: Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management
